fields.label: Preferred state

fields.label: Monthly rental budget
fields.effect: Only listings whose monthly rent falls in the selected range remain eligible.

fields.label: Preferred area
fields.effect: Only listings whose city or address mentions the area remain eligible.

fields.label: Search
fields.effect: Only listings whose title, address, city, type or id match the text remain eligible.

fields.label: Business type
fields.effect: Orders the eligible set and selects the category evidence shown on each card. It does not remove properties.

fields.label: Target market
fields.effect: The catalogue records no customer-mix field, so this is reported per property as a requirement that cannot be verified. It neither filters nor ranks.

pu_eligibility.score_meaning: Uncalibrated P-vs-U research association index, not a probability of commercial success.
